method: Fast completion: fill direct audited source values first, then estimate missing values from median ratios in matching food categories. Exact existing values are never overwritten.

scope.unitBasis: g per 100 g; g per 100 ml for liquids

sources: Existing completed database records in the same food category, excluding the target block, used only for median-ratio estimates.
